name: career-compass
description: Honest job-fit checks in chat. Try it now: paste your resume and a job posting and ask "Do I fit this?" No posting at hand? Ask for "a sample Career Compass fit check" to see one first. Then tailor your resume, write the cover letter, and prep the interview without padding your history. In Claude Code and Cowork it also remembers your career history and tracks every application, on your own computer.

data_path.title: Career data folder
data_path.description: Where your career history and job pipeline are kept, as plain YAML on this computer. Nothing is uploaded. Leave the default unless you want it somewhere specific, such as inside a folder you already back up.
